pattern_explanation: Each of these Portuguese words shares a Latin root with an English word, so the spelling looks familiar. Over time the meanings drifted apart in each language, so the resemblance can mislead an English reader.
false_friend_warning: Beware: the Portuguese word meaning current looks like the English word 'actual', and the Portuguese word meaning occasional looks like the English word 'eventual', which in English means final or ultimate. Matching by spelling gives the wrong English meaning in both cases.
